brief.working_title: The 4-Hour Workweek, Rebuilt for AI Architects in 2026
brief.subject: A chapter-by-chapter refinement of The 4-Hour Workweek for governed AI, deterministic automation, human specialists, and founder agency
brief.origin: User-authorized FrankX viewpoint, the complete DEAL chapter map, first-party AI documentation, and current productivity evidence
brief.thesis: The modern four-hour workweek is an operating model whose intent, decision rights, evidence, and exceptions are explicit enough that AI and human specialists can execute without making the founder the default router; definition and elimination still precede automation.
brief.reader: Founder, creator, executive, or expert operator trying to reclaim time without surrendering judgment or control
brief.reader_baseline: The reader associates a four-hour week with productivity tricks, passive-income claims, or replacing virtual assistants with chatbots.
brief.reader_delta: The reader can translate every DEAL chapter into a governed operating practice, route work by consequence, and run a 90-day absence test.
brief.stakes: Automation can compound waste and error as quickly as it compounds useful work; a time dividend requires elimination, governance, ownership, and deliberate allocation.
brief.strongest_objection: AI productivity effects are uneven and sometimes negative for experienced workers, so no tool stack can honestly promise a four-hour week.
brief.commercial_relationship: All references use direct official or research links. No issued customer-referral URL was verified for this release, so no affiliate link is published.

claims.text: The book's operational structure is Definition, Elimination, Automation, and Liberation, with the article mapping the complete official chapter sequence.
Generative AI can improve speed or output quality in some bounded work, but observed effects vary by task, worker experience, workflow, and measurement design.
AI creates technical capacity for a time dividend; elimination, governance, ownership, and allocation determine whether that capacity becomes leisure, better work, or more expected output.

Current AI products span conversational assistance, repository work, connected workspace tasks, real-time public-signal retrieval, customizable open-weight systems, and European model/code-agent options; they are not interchangeable employees.
